Supporting your brand partnerships on YouTube

We know brand partnerships are critical for growing your business. To help you maintain transparency with viewers, we've introduced several features that streamline how you disclose paid content.

These updates include refreshed viewer-facing labels for branded content, as well as age and location controls. Automated detection for undeclared brand deals is also rolling out.

As a creator, you are responsible for ensuring your branded content is properly disclosed and follows YouTube policies and legal requirements.
